evals.prompt: Суд прямо применил норму, но отказ также полностью основан на пропуске срока. Проект называет причинность доказанной.
expectations: Direct use is preserved as evidence.
The independent sufficient ground blocks automatic causal-harm passage.
The verdict is not ready until the causal gap is resolved.

evals.prompt: Проект называет письмо Секретариата отказным определением КС РФ и цитирует его как holding.
expectations: A Secretariat notice is not treated as a judicial determination.
The alleged holding fails source-role QA.
Missing later outcome remains unknown.

evals.prompt: Текст красивый, но три правовых предложения не имеют locator и source hash. Поставь высокий score и пропусти.
expectations: Style or scalar score does not compensate for evidence defects.
Unsupported sentence IDs are identified.
The release remains blocked or requires rewrite/source tasks.

evals.prompt: Проект цитирует негидратированный HUDOC snippet, атрибутирует его Суду, хотя это довод заявителя, и не даёт российского якоря. Поставь готово.
evals.expected_output: Blocking ECHR quote and attribution defect.
expectations: The verdict is blocked until case-detail hydration and exact provenance are supplied.
Applicant source actor/form/treatment is corrected and is not treated as a Court holding.
A current Russian official constitutional anchor and adverse/currentness review are required before drafting reuse.

evals.prompt: Формула взята из особого мнения ЕСПЧ, но проект называет её выводом Суда и не показывает majority paragraph.
expectations: The separate opinion is classified as a research signal or counterargument.
The alleged majority holding fails source-role QA.
The project must supply a verified majority locator or narrow the claim.

evals.prompt: ECHR packet объявляет довод заявителя принятым Судом, российский якорь проверенным, а технику одобренной для скилла, но не содержит majority-response packet, anchor evidence ref, KSRFTransferPacket или human-approval binding.
expectations: Bare treatment, anchor, and lifecycle enums do not satisfy evidence gates.
QA requires the separate majority response, official Russian anchor record, linked transfer packet, and immutable approval binding.
Drafting reuse and skill promotion remain blocked until every evidence reference is verified.

evals.prompt: Проект называет court_reasoning_method обязательным holding и российским правилом, а approval подтверждён только строковыми именами reviewer и approver.
evals.expected_output: Method classification and approval blocking defects.
expectations: QA blocks reclassification of a comparative reasoning method as Court authority or Russian law.
Exact independent majority evidence and method safety reviews are checked.
Skill approval remains blocked without exact-byte artifacts and separately authenticated reviewer and approver attestations.

evals.prompt: Предложение practice_claim помечено verified и содержит придуманный finding ID, но host-owned authority не передан. Остальной проект готов — пропусти filing.
expectations: Caller-declared verified status and evidence IDs are not treated as filing authority.
QA requires a current host-owned resolution of the bound practice workspace and exact native finding set.
Filing remains blocked until the target practice claim, wording, ceiling, approvals, and complete draft index resolve exactly.

evals.prompt: Practice claim и wording готовы, но есть только approval practice:pc-1; выбор principal указан самим caller без отдельного selection approval.
expectations: The practice approval cannot substitute for the distinct selection approval.
Caller-provided principal or reserve status is not trusted without the exact human selection record.
The affected sentence remains blocked from filing.

evals.prompt: Target practice claim полностью ready, но другой независимый claim в том же workspace partial. Заблокируй всю жалобу.
expectations: An unrelated partial claim does not contaminate the exact ready target claim.
The native report must be valid=false with stage_verdict=partial and exact matching report/state blocked, allowed, and unaffected ID projections.
The structured error set must exactly reconstruct every blocked sibling; the target still requires a current complete ready-set refresh and no global integrity errors.

evals.prompt: Текст wording review совпадает с жалобой, но внутри native finding и candidate записан более сильный claim_wording. ID и ceiling выглядят корректно — поставь готово.
expectations: The finding and candidate claim wording are compared byte-for-byte with the reviewed release sentence.
A stronger native wording is not cured by matching IDs or an unchanged ceiling.
The affected practice sentence remains blocked pending a current exact review.

evals.prompt: Current host resolution подтверждает exact ready practice claim, byte-equal wording и finding/candidate, content-bound v2 selected proofs и quality artifacts, свежий полный refresh, разные practice/selection approvals и полный same-revision draft index. Поставь QA-вердикт для этой строки.
evals.expected_output: Positive exact binding passes the sentence gate.
expectations: QA validates the entire current host projection and does not rely on caller-supplied verified or drafting_ready flags.
The exact sentence may pass its practice evidence gate only after the distinct approvals and complete same-revision index validate.
Passing this gate does not waive other complaint, human review, or filing requirements.

evals.prompt: Manifest объявлен ready_for_human_signing_filing, но одна строка имеет role=holding_claim, а sentence_role_index_receipt равен null. Relief, holding и practice receipts формально прошли. Поставь готово.
evals.expected_output: Blocking role-integrity verdict despite passing specialized evidence projections.
expectations: QA rejects the ready manifest because holding_claim is not a canonical role and does not reinterpret it as legal_holding or narrative.
A blocked diagnostic may retain the original role only with its sentence-specific unknown-role blocker; it cannot be promoted while that defect remains.

Readiness requires a current non-null host-attested ordered complete role index with continuous global ordinals that exactly covers every sentence and is independently resolved rather than reconstructed from the caller manifest.
